items.title: Voice works only in Chrome; Firefox + Brave fail silently
items.root_cause: ASR is window.SpeechRecognition/webkitSpeechRecognition in public/buzzy/talk.html startListening(). Firefox has no such API. Brave exposes it but returns service-not-allowed (Google speech service blocked by default). startListening used to return silently when SR was absent, so the mic lit up and nothing happened; error codes other than not-allowed were ignored.
shipped: 7403270 explicit unsupported-browser + error-code messages, honest exit from listen mode
<next> voice.note persists the message through paintVoice repaints (paintVoice was wiping it instantly)
e2069ee server ASR: POST /api/buzzy/transcribe (session-gated, raw WAV body, gpt-audio-mini, no new key)
e2069ee client recorder fallback: getUserMedia + ScriptProcessor -> 16k mono WAV -> transcribe -> same turn
7c7570c silence is never a transcript: SILENCE sentinel + refusal filter
b8c74ee client skips upload when RMS saw no speech; server drops meta-answers
feat: §asr_ms recorded with lane='asr' in buzzy_voice_metrics
items.evidence: Prod: transcribe 200 with exact transcript, asr_ms 917-1089 for a 6.5s clip; silence clip -> {"text":""}; unauth -> 401. Browser matrix (authenticated): chrome-natural/brave-natural show 'Mic or speech service blocked'; noSR cases show the recorder taking over. Recorder E2E with a real spoken WAV as the fake mic: chrome 475KB -> correct transcript 1.37s; brave 480KB -> correct transcript 3.11s. Real Firefox (playwright firefox 151, no SpeechRecognition): recorder path opens the mic, posts, handles an empty transcript by re-arming, no JS errors from our code. Timing on a 6.55s utterance + 3s pad: VAD ends the clip 0.88s after speech stops, transcript lands 1.20s after the clip ends (asr_ms 1201). Ops read-back shows lane='asr', asr_ms 978.
items.next: 1) Prove a real Firefox page (install playwright firefox) takes the recorder path without JS errors. 2) Real end-of-speech timing: measure time from 'stop talking' to transcript for a normal 3-5s utterance. 3) Record asr_ms into buzzy_voice_metrics so ops can see it.
items.done_when: Transcript -> SSE audio proven on Chromium and Firefox, or an explicit in-product statement that voice is Chrome/Edge-only with typed chat everywhere.
items.open: A real Firefox microphone on Shane's machine is still unproven (headless fake streams are tone/silence, not speech). Everything else is verified.

items.title: Bulk skills + 4,000 image upload path
items.done_when: Archive import streams to storage, dedupes by hash, keeps structure, per-file report; proven with 4,000-file fixture.
items.evidence: API benchmark with a generated 4,000-file corpus (3,900 images + 100 markdown): first pass 4,000 stored, 0 failed, 65.3s at 61.3 files/s concurrency 10; second pass 4,000 duplicates, 0 stored, 66.9s. GET /api/buzzy/assets reports files=4000 totalBytes=184256. Download of one asset: 200, content-type image/png, correct bytes; unauthenticated 401. UI: /buzzy/upload folder picker, 110 real files -> 110 POSTs -> 'Done. 0 new, 110 already here, 0 failed'; after touching one file -> '1 new, 109 already here, 0 failed'.
items.open: Bytes live in Postgres bytea (25 MB/file cap). Fine for a corpus of thousands of small files; a corpus of large media would want object storage (S3/R2) with signed URLs. No zip import — the folder walk covers the same job and stays resumable.

items.title: Music + 3D surfaces
items.done_when: Generated audio / 3D artifact ends as a downloadable file card in chat.
items.found: Generation providers: the Nous gateway has 378 models — audio (gpt-audio) and image (gemini-3-pro-image) but NO music and NO 3D. FAL_KEY is present but returns 401 'invalid key credentials'. MINIMAX_API_KEY is empty. So nothing can generate music or 3D today.
items.shipped: Dropped images/audio/.glb/.gltf now upload to the content-addressed asset store and render in the chat as a card: image preview, audio player, or a labelled 3D file, each with a working download (/api/buzzy/assets/:id).
items.evidence: Authenticated E2E: dropped asr-probe.mp3 -> card with <audio> + download /api/buzzy/assets/8221 (audio/mpeg, 104832 bytes); dropped triangle.gltf -> card with download /api/buzzy/assets/8222 (1024 bytes). 0 console errors. Assets listing shows both.
items.open: 1) A music model needs a working provider key (FAL key is dead; MiniMax unset) or a local model. 2) A real 3D viewer needs an engine vendored into the page (three.js ~600 KB) — a bundle-size decision, not sneaked in.

items.title: Node-graph orchestration in the whiteboard (6a-6e)
items.done_when: Saved graph runs end to end; frontier-position model selection via cached Arena adapter; review node provably on a different provider; per-node status/cost.

phases.6a: done — migration 0049 + save/list/read API proven in prod
phases.6b: done — frontier.json cached ranking, resolvePin/resolveReview, GET /api/buzzy/frontier
phases.6c: done (resolver level) — review pins resolve to a different provider; recording happens per node result in 6e
phases.6d: done — /buzzy/graph whiteboard: add/drag/link nodes, per-kind config, live resolution preview, save+version, reopen. Per-node status/cost needs a run (6e).
phases.6e: done — runner.ts: dependency order, bounded retries (2), per-attempt persistence, gate stop/resume, replay from stored outputs

items.evidence: Prod: POST /api/buzzy/graphs saved graph_x7j06212k666 (4 nodes incl. a review node and a gate, 3 typed edges), list shows nodes=4, read-back returns positions and the review config, resave bumped version to 2 with no duplicate rows, dangling edge and bad kind both 400, anonymous 401. Frontier: writing positions 1/2/3 -> google, moonshotai, qwen; pos 99 -> z-ai with substituted:true 'asked for position 99, took 5'; unknown category 400; cross-provider review of google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite on coding -> deepseek, independent:true. | Whiteboard E2E: 4 nodes added, 3 links drawn and persisted as n1->n2:data, n2->n3:review, n3->n4:gate, review node pinned to writing position 2 resolves to moonshotai/kimi-k3 in the inspector, saved v1, reopened from the list with 4 nodes and 3 edges, 0 console errors. | Resolver E2E: graph with agent+review+gate ran in 6913ms -> write done on google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite (900ms), critique done on moonshotai/kimi-k3 (5558ms, independent=true) with a real critique, gate awaiting_approval; approve -> run done, 3 results, read_back ok. Retry proven: a glm node failed on attempt 1 and succeeded on attempt 2 (3 result rows for 2 nodes). Spec freeze proven: after shrinking the authored graph to one node the finished run still reports its original 2 nodes and order. UI: Run renders per-node badges ('done · google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite · 858 ms') and the Approve button appears on a gated run; 0 console errors. Anonymous run 401.
items.open: Cost reads $0.0000 because the deployment's model catalog carries no per-token prices; the columns and the arithmetic are in place, the numbers need BZ_CHAT_MODELS price fields. Frontier ranking is still a hand-ordered seed, and refresh() is not built.
